content:
deploy-bot: New hotpatch built: registry.redwood/inference/conn-throttle:hotpatch-2026-03-23-bc12
deploy-bot: Starting gated canary in dedicated-us-west-2 (3% -> 15% ramp). Monitoring 12m. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/inference/releases/bc12

ana: sorry team, prod alerts from two large Dedicated tenants for connection saturation. Appreciate fast patch.

marco: any risk of increasing tail latency with throttle? we tuned earlier to avoid backpressure loops.

infra-sam: change is conservative: reduces per-actor connection cap from 800->450 and adds a backoff jitter. Verified in perf tests. Small risk but should reduce queueing.

ops-lead: propose explicit rollback gates before we move beyond 15%: rollback if errors >1.8% for 4m OR p95 >1.3s for 6m OR connection_queue_length rising >40% over baseline for 3m.

release-manager: required approvals: ops-lead + infra-sam + oncall. I will post a brief release note on approval.

oncall-lee: I'm on duty and can monitor. +1 from oncall, will escalate if I see restart churn.

infra-sam: +1 after code review and perf checks. small diff, no DB schema changes.

ops-lead: +1. Because Dedicated customers are affected, expedite but keep rollback manual.

release-manager: Approval checklist satisfied. Draft note: "hotpatch: connection throttling tweak to reduce client stalls in dedicated pools. Rolling now; will notify CS thread." Link: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-23-conn-throttle

marco: okay proceed. execute canary command and post logs.

infra-sam: running: ```/deploy canary --svc conn-proxy --image registry.redwood/inference/conn-throttle:hotpatch-2026-03-23-bc12 --canary 3% --step 15% --monitor 12m```

deploy-bot: Canary initiated -> 3% then ramping to 15% over 6m. Observing metrics.

(deploy-bot automated update) 3272223350: canary snapshot (2m): errors 1.1%, p95 720ms, conn_queued_avg 12, restarts 0

ana: logs show fewer "accept timeout" traces. Early positive sign.

marco: run a short 15% soak for 5m then recommend +1 to full if stable.

infra-sam: initiating soak: ```/deploy soak --svc conn-proxy --to 15% --duration 5m```

(deploy-bot automated update) 3272223365: soak snapshot: errors 1.05%, p95 760ms, conn_queued_avg 10, restarts 0

oncall-lee: still watching dashboards, will trigger rollback if criteria met. No signs yet.

ops-lead: given metrics below rollback thresholds, approve promoting to 50% now; keep 30m post-promote watch.

infra-sam: promoting: ```/deploy promote --svc conn-proxy --to 50%```

deploy-bot: Promotion started -> target 50% traffic. ETA full traffic shift ~3m.

(deploy-bot automated update) 3272223385: promotion complete. final metrics: errors 0.9%, p95 680ms, conn_queued_avg 9, restarts 0. All checks green.

release-manager: Published release note and pinged CS with impacted tenant list. Will follow up with post-deploy verification email.

ops-lead: Good job. Keep rollback playbook on deck for 60m. If anything surfaces, oncall to call seq rollback and dev to revert image.

ana: thanks team. I'll file a short post-deploy blameless note and close once we see 48h stability. :thumbsup:
